rationale: A repository nobody scans accumulates images whose vulnerabilities are only discovered by whoever exploits them. Scanning is what turns the registry into an inventory of known exposure, and it has to happen without anyone asking for it: an image is pushed once and pulled for months afterwards, so a manual scan only describes the day it was run.
remediation: Set the registry scanning configuration to scan the repository continuously, which hands it to Amazon Inspector, or failing that turn on scan on push for the repository
